detaileddescription.para: This is the numeric form of the ROSE version number. It's formed by taking the ROSE version string from the ROSE_VERSION file at the top of the source tree (e.g., "0.9.6.399-rc1", replacing all non-numeric characters with '.', ("0.9.6.399...1"), deleting dots that are repeated ("0.9.6.399.1"), discarding all but the first three numeric values ("0.9.6"), forming an integer using three digits per version part ("000009006"), and removing leading zeros ("9006").
